jtbd.jtbd_title: Common App essay workbench (scenes → beats → thesis)
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Stand up a repeatable essay pipeline: clip bank → scene cards → beat sheet → thesis line → 600→650 edit.

interactions.user_ask: How do I keep my voice while tightening the draft?
interactions.jenny_reply: Lock a one-line thesis, then trim any sentence that doesn’t advance it or a scene beat. Replace abstractions with sensory verbs.
Time+place, 1 action, 1 obstacle, 1 shift. If you can’t name the shift, it’s not a scene.
Cut preambles; start late, end early. Move context into 3-5 word “hinge” phrases.

outcomes.details: Clip bank → scene cards → beat sheet → thesis → 650 polish.
